Iteration (fuel from booking audit): completed L-024 (MCP create-recurring atomicity). Hoisted a single prisma.$transaction around the whole occurrence loop (lock once up front), mirroring recurring.ts — a mid-series conflict now rolls back every occurrence (all-or-nothing) instead of leaving orphaned confirmed appointments + a misleading 'nothing created' error. tests/mcp-recurring-atomicity.test.ts (2): whole series in ONE tx; mid-series conflict → error. VERIFIED: 2/2, typecheck+lint clean, full suite green, gate PENDING. FLAGGED L-028 (illegal status transitions) as owner:true — it's CONTRADICTORY: getValidStatusTransitions forbids all terminal-state transitions but the server/v1/MCP deliberately allow cancelled/no_show→active (un-cancel). Whether un-cancel is legal is a product decision; the loop won't guess.

Ported the guard (advisory lock + in-tx conflict re-check + CONFLICT→clean error) into mcp/tools/appointments.ts + tests/mcp-update-status-reactivation.test.ts (3, non-vacuous). VERIFIED: new test 3/3, typecheck+lint clean, full suite green, gate PENDING. Filed remaining 9 as L-024..L-032 (recurring atomicity, DST drift ×2, buffer-not-reserved, illegal transitions, 3× tz-boundary, soft-deleted-service booking, stale-reactivation-flags).
